Meeting to Consider Engineer's Report - Glencoe Outlet Drain 2026
1.
7 1 PUB MTG Meeting to Consider - Glencoe Outlet Drain 2026.pdf
Council shall consider the report prepared by Spriet Associates dated November 16, 2026 and shall give opportunity to any person who owns lands within the area requiring drainage who have not signed the petition an opportunity to do so and/or remove their name(s) from the petition.
Meeting Order:
a. Engineer/Staff will give an overview of the work required
b. The Chair will ask if there are any questions from any affected property owners whom are present
c. The Chair will ask if there are any requests from those present to add or remove their name(s) from the petition
d. The Chair will ask if there are any comments or questions from Members of Council
e. Decision from Council (first and second reading of the by-law later in the agenda, if passed)
Recommended Motion:
That the Council of the Municipality of Southwest Middlesex accept the Engineer's Report in reference to the Glencoe Outlet Drain 2026 and refers the by-law to the By-law section of the agenda for a first and second reading.
